name: Türkiye
description: Rapidly rising sovereign aerospace power developing the TAI TF Kaan 5th-gen stealth fighter, operating large upgraded F-16 Block 50+ fleets, and leading world unmanned combat aviation (Bayraktar TB2/TB3, Akinci, Kizilelma).

militaryBranches.name: Turkish Air Force
militaryBranches.description: TAI TF Kaan (Testing), F-16C/D Fighting Falcon (Özgür Modernization), Akinci UCAV, and E-7T Peace Eagle.

militaryBranches.name: Turkish Naval Aviation
militaryBranches.description: TCG Anadolu drone carrier wings (Bayraktar TB3, Kizilelma), P-72 ASW, and S-70B Seahawk.

militaryBranches.name: Turkish Army Aviation
militaryBranches.description: T129 ATAK attack helicopters, T929 Heavy Attack, and CH-47F Chinooks.
